rationale: Sanvith and Akash are both AI co-founders in the Bay Area working on complementary infrastructure: Sanvith's Reasoning Company focuses on advancing reasoning capabilities in AI systems (ML research), while Akash's Contrastive Labs works on ML infrastructure. Their domains create natural technical synergy—reasoning systems require robust ML infrastructure—and both bring founder-level context to understand each other's challenges.
intro_message: Sanvith Reddy Munagala, meet Akash Bhat — you're both building foundational AI infrastructure in the Bay Area and could compare notes on the reasoning vs. infra side of the stack.
